# 4 bedroom detached house for sale

> This Harron Homes property is located on the outskirts of Chesterfield town centre and is conveniently placed for all amenities. Sainsburys supermarket is a stone throws away and there are additional amenities in the nearby areas of Brimington and Whittington Moor including doctors and dentists. Transport links are excellent and the M1 motorway is within easy access.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bedrooms
- Plocha: 123 m²
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Energetická náročnost: B
- Lokalita: Poppy Crescent, Derbyshire
- Cena: £375,000
